source: make a clicker game where you tap for clicks and I want a VERY DETAILED map that I can walk around in, give me a button on my screen called adminenpanel that only I HAVE and make it so I can do events and give clicks, there is to be no labels around the map or on the ground and I want a rebirth button on my screen and rebirthing doubles how much you get per click

answers.ask: You asked for a very detailed map but did not say what it is - a city, a forest, an island, something else?
answers.answer: Make it a detailed modern city map, with streets, buildings, parks, and interior-style decorative detail but no labels placed around the map or on the ground.

answers.ask: How big should the walkable area be - a plaza, a neighbourhood, or a whole world?
answers.answer: Use a neighbourhood-sized walkable area so it feels detailed and explorable while staying focused for the clicker game.

scene_prompt: Create a detailed modern city neighbourhood map with a focused, fully walkable area. Arrange streets between varied buildings, with parks and interior-style decorative detail throughout; do not place labels, signs with text, or ground markings that function as labels anywhere in the map.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation: the tapping, accumulating, and rebirth progression identifies an incremental clicker. Use the `world-shared` shape: one detailed, persistent neighbourhood surface that players can freely walk around rather than isolated plots. The matched preset is Incremental Simulator; retain its shared-world form, but do not add its unrequested progression gates or bazaar geometry.

### Shape and preset
`world-shared` is a compact, fully explorable modern city neighbourhood, organized as connected public streets and blocks rather than a linear route. The preset is Incremental Simulator.

### Config requirements
Use visible `path-circulation` for the network of streets, sidewalks, crossings without text, and park paths linking every block. Use visible `settlement-density` for a built-up neighbourhood of varied urban buildings rather than scattered structures. No invisible layout options are required. Do not render labels, text signage, named ground markings, or other readable map text.

### Layout components
Make a medium-sized neighbourhood centered on a broad pedestrian-friendly intersection and small plaza, with four to six surrounding blocks. Run connected asphalt streets around and through the blocks, with continuous sidewalks, curb cuts, streetlights, benches, planters, trees, bike racks, bus-shelter-like forms without text, and parked vehicles as decorative props. Place varied modern low- and mid-rise buildings along the street edges: storefront-like façades, apartment entrances, office fronts, corner buildings, recessed lobbies visible through windows, awnings without lettering, rooftop equipment, balconies, stairwells, and exterior service details. Include two small parks on opposite blocks: one greener lawn-and-tree park with winding paths and seating, and one paved pocket park with a fountain or sculptural centerpiece without inscriptions. Keep all decorative interior-style detail visible through windows or in open vestibules; buildings are not specified as enterable. Use block edges, building rows, trees, and distant façade silhouettes as the boundary, while keeping the walkable street-and-park network clearly open and connected. Frame the scene in an isometric three-quarter view with the central intersection and both parks legible.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: this is an exploratory neighbourhood with no topology whose invalidity would make a defined course or objective unplayable, so the visual city composition leads.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by a focused neighbourhood-sized walkable area with several dense blocks. Theme: detailed clean modern urban streetscape, lively but text-free. Pipeline modifier: `P0`; it is a single exterior ground surface with no forced overhangs, interiors, separate maps, volumetric movement, or validity-by-construction requirement.
